description: Generate a shareable link for external clients to connect their social accounts to the workspace. Can be scoped to specific platforms and return the user to your own app when done. A one-platform link that your own product opens can skip the PostFast connect page (skipConnectPage).

email.description: Recipient email (required when sendEmail is true)

externalId.description: Your own reference for this link, echoed back unchanged on the return URL. Letters, digits and - . _ ~ : @ only.

platforms.description: Restrict the link to these platforms, e.g. ["INSTAGRAM"]. Omit to offer all of them. Enforced server-side, so a scoped link cannot connect any other platform.

redirectUrl.description: Where the connect page offers to send the user once connecting finishes (with skipConnectPage, the user is sent there directly), with status, platform, accountId and externalId on the query string, plus accountIds (every account connected, comma-separated) after a Facebook or LinkedIn page step. For Facebook, accountId is the first chosen Page. needsBoard=true means the Pinterest account has no board yet, and needsLocation=true that the Google Business Profile account has no location yet; it needs one before it can post. A failed connect returns status=error and message (plus externalId) instead. Must be https (http is accepted only on localhost).

skipConnectPage.description: Skip the PostFast connect page, for a link your own product opens: the user goes straight to the platform's login and, with redirectUrl, straight back to it when done. Needs exactly one platform in platforms, and not with sendEmail. LINKEDIN, BLUESKY and TELEGRAM links show the connect page anyway, and a FACEBOOK link still stops at the Pages picker before returning.
